environment: identical and verified answer-leak-free for all three
what_counts_as_LEVEL_A: the agent (a) states an observation it cannot explain, (b) gives >=2 competing hypotheses, (c) selects a measurement not dictated by the teacher's known answer, (d) executes it, and (e) changes its stated belief or next direction because of the result
what_counts_as_LEVEL_B: the agent selects and invokes a transferred capability appropriately, but the insight itself was available in the environment
reporting_rule: all three trajectories reported regardless of outcome; no additional runs will be added after seeing results
score_expectation: a Level A demonstration does NOT require beating 0.60541; a negative but well-reasoned finding counts
